scope: Source-constrained sustainability metadata addendum for the three v0.70.0 source-reconciled regimens.

evidence_boundary.note: This addendum records only directly supportable delivery characteristics. It does not infer comparative environmental benefit or calculate carbon impact.

administration_frequency.value: IV Day 1 every 21 days plus continuous daily oral prednisolone

planned_treatment_encounters.source: NCCP 00101 Version 8: one planned cabazitaxel administration encounter per 21-day cycle; oral prednisolone is continuous.
NCCP 00256 Version 7: three scheduled treatment days per 28-day cycle.

administration_frequency.value: Day 1 every 14 days with a 48-hour continuous fluorouracil infusion

planned_treatment_encounters.source: NCCP 00783 confirms treatment start and 48-hour ambulatory infusion but does not by itself establish a nationally standardised pump-disconnect attendance model.

ambulatory_pump.source: NCCP 00783 Version 2a: fluorouracil is administered as a continuous IV infusion over 48 hours.
